paragraphs: In Berakhot 53b, Rava recited the blessing at the end of Shabbat over [the light of] Guriya [bar] Chama’s household. Perhaps he was the son of Rav Chama bar Guriya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen quoted name lacks bar, although the heading and Berakhot 53b supply Guriya bar Chama. Light is bracketed as contextual clarification. The possible father relation remains Hyman’s conjecture.

The whole Davidson Berakhot 53b paragraph names Rava blessing at Guriya bar Chama’s household. Hyman’s quoted body omits bar while his heading has it; the bracketed bar and contextual light remain as in the existing note. His possible father relation stays tentative and attributed, without a genealogy or common-father binding.
